non_licensed.comments: Carson City is just a city within the state of Nevada and does not have separate collection agency license requirements. If we were to open a physical location in Carson City, a basic business license would be required, but nothing specific to collection agency from outside the city.

Section 36a-801 of the Connecticut General Statutes, requires activity subject to licensure to be conducted at an office in a state, as defined in section 36a-2. State means any state of the United States, the District of Columbia, any territory of the United States, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa, the trust territory of the Pacific Islands, the Virgin Islands and the Northern Mariana Islands.

Every individual applicant, every officer and director of a corporate applicant, and every member of a firm or partnership applicant for a license as a collection agency or collection agent must submit proof satisfactory to the Commissioner that he or she: 5.
